data.title: Octopus populations soar in warming UK waters
data.description: LONDON - A surge in octopus numbers in British waters due to unusually warm seas is presenting fishermen with an interesting new catch — albeit one that is devouring one of their usual staples.

data.title: UN says food crisis ‘looming’ after global energy shock
data.description: Rising energy and fertiliser costs are hitting smallholder farmers and driving up prices of agricultural commodities, fuelling fears of a global food crisis, according to the head of the UN agriculture development fund.

data.title: Pope celebrates mass in hospital after cancer surgery
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV celebrated mass on Friday at the hospital where he is recovering from a lung cancer operation, as seen in the first images of him released by the Vatican since the procedure.

data.title: Italy braces for ‘autumn of discontent’
data.description: MILAN - Italy is preparing for a turbulent autumn following a spike in inflation because of energy prices, with students, truck drivers and farmers taking to the streets ahead of elections next year.

data.title: Elon Musk unveils Tesla’s ‘flying’ car
data.description: HOUSTON - Tesla CEO Elon Musk unveiled what he described as a "flying" car, equipped with thrusters, during a livestreamed event at his SpaceX rocket company on Thursday.

data.title: Expert urges Thai banks to join green finance network
data.description: Thailand’s financial institutions should join an international green finance capacity-building network and help develop training materials tailored to the local market, according to Ma Jun, a leading Chinese green finance expert.

data.title: ONE Championship: Grigorian–Luo bout in doubt after Samurai 4 weigh-in failures
data.description: Marat Grigorian’s ONE Samurai featherweight kickboxing tournament semi-final against Luo Chao appears unlikely to go ahead after neither fighter appeared at Friday evening’s face-offs in Tokyo.

data.title: Cost-of-living protests to grip pre-election France
data.description: PARIS - After weeks of student protests, France is set to be swept by broader, nationwide demonstrations Saturday over the cost of living, setting up a potentially fraught period ahead of presidential elections next year.

data.title: Anutin confident of joining OECD by 2028
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul is confident Thailand remains on track to join the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) by 2028 after receiving positive feedback from its secretary-general on the country’s preparations.

data.title: China seeks closer ties on clean energy, high tech
data.description: A senior Chinese embassy official has highlighted the resilience of China’s economy and its readiness to deepen cooperation with Thailand in high-tech industries and clean energy to support the country’s economic development.

data.title: Lumphini’s lizards star in winning urban wildlife photo
data.description: A photograph of monitor lizards in Bangkok’s Lumphini Park by UK photographer Seth Forestson has won the Urban Wildlife category of Wildlife Photographer of the Year, an annual competition run by the Natural History Museum in London.

data.title: Protesters blocked from reaching IMF meeting venue
data.description: Demonstrators faced a police blockade banning them on Friday from marching to the meeting venue of the World Bank and International Monetary Fund to air grievances against the two institutions.

data.title: AIT Hosted Nearly 200 Experts from 79 Countries to Advance IPCC Climate Mitigation Report
data.description: The Asian Institute of Technology (AIT) hosted nearly 200 climate experts from 79 countries from Sept 28 to Oct 2 to advance the preparation of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change’s (IPCC) next global assessment of climate change mitigation.

data.title: France’s education divide laid bare by protests
data.description: BAGNOLET, France - Students cheered as they stacked rubbish bins against the entrance to a school outside Paris, while a speaker thumped out French rap to young people, teachers and parents mingling in the early morning drizzle.

data.title: Spotting the Beast in Plain Sight: How to Outrun the 'Gray Rhino' Charging Straight at Us
data.description: At a Bangkok panel, risk strategist Michele Wucker and CNN’s Richard Quest unpicked why leaders ignore obvious threats—and how to harness them

data.title: Tuk-tuk driver fined over B4,000 fare demand from tourists
data.description: Police have fined a tuk-tuk driver 1,500 baht after he demanded 4,000 baht from two Russian tourists, who attended The Weeknd: After Hours Til Dawn Tour for a journey to Sukhumvit 4, although they ultimately paid him only 400 baht.

data.title: Thai farmers, fishermen challenge IMF, World Bank in Bangkok
data.description: Thai farmers, fishermen and workers marched through Bangkok on Friday as global finance and business leaders gathered for IMF and World Bank meetings, demanding a say in policies shaping their livelihoods.

data.title: 200 tonnes of hazardous aluminium byproduct seized in Samut Sakhon
data.description: Authorities seized more than 200 tonnes of suspected aluminium dross stored in a warehouse in Muang district of Samut Sakhon province on Friday.
